details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1047-1113 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` treats V2 pack/chunk-post failures as success and leaves partial comment chains behind.
  WHY: the caller continues with unpersisted state, and the next poll can fall back to stale V1 state and repeat work.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1098-1113 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk` discards all `gh api` stdout/stderr, so failed chunk posts lose API diagnostics.
  WHY: operators only get a generic error and cannot distinguish auth, rate-limit, validation, or network failures.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-591 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` accepts arbitrarily large positive integers.
  WHY: one attempt can consume the full 60-minute step budget and starve the retry loop.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:341-344 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_is_state_comment` treats any body containing the marker substring as a state comment.
  WHY: prose mentions of the marker can be filtered out of tracking-comment tests.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-158 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: the overlap filter removes `must_not_contain` patterns whenever their regex source is a strict substring of a `must_contain` regex on the same file.
  WHY: a legitimate forbidden line can be dropped from verification, so a real regression may be missed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1160-1184 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: the V2 extract path accepts `candidate_state` after schema checks without an independent size/manifest bound.
  WHY: malformed bytes that still parse as the expected JSON shape can be ingested as state and poison the poller.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:230-248 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `stitched_b64` is normalized with `re.sub(r"\s+", "", ...)` before decoding.
  WHY: whitespace introduced by rendering or corruption is erased, making torn-chain diagnostics less distinct.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:232-249 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_extract` does not validate the manifest's declared part count against a reasonable bound.
  WHY: a corrupted `part=1/total=999999` comment could force the extractor to track excessive chunks.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1065-1090 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` returns 0 on all failure paths, so callers cannot tell persistence failed.
  WHY: pack failure, empty chunks, or a chunk-post failure are all converted into success, which can leave the poller operating on stale persisted state.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-590 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` accepts unbounded positive integers.
  WHY: a very large value can make the first attempt consume the whole step budget and defeat the retry loop.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1108-1110 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk` discards API error diagnostics.
  WHY: `gh api` stderr/stdout is redirected to `/dev/null`, so persistent posting failures do not expose the HTTP or network cause.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:341-344 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_is_state_comment` uses substring containment, not pattern matching.
  WHY: a normal comment that mentions `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1` or `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2` could be misclassified as a state comment in tests.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-590 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The per-attempt timeout override accepts any positive integer without an upper bound.
  WHY: a large value can consume the entire 60-minute step budget on one attempt and defeat the intended retry budget.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1098-1101 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The V2 chunk POST helper discards both stdout and stderr, losing API error diagnostics.
  WHY: when chunk posting fails, the caller only gets a generic error message with no GitHub API context.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1047-1090 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a V2 chunk fails to post, `post_state_comment` logs an error but returns 0.
  WHY: the orchestrator can continue with in-memory state that was never persisted, which can later diverge from the tracking issue and lead to duplicate work.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-590 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The timeout override has no upper bound.
  WHY: a misconfigured value can let one attempt consume most or all of the 60-minute step budget before retries run.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:232-249 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `cmd_extract` does not validate the manifest's declared part count against a reasonable bound.
  WHY: a corrupted comment with an extreme `part=1/total=...` value could make the extractor track an excessive number of chunks.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-591 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The validation regex accepts any positive integer with no upper bound.
  WHY: an excessively large timeout value can consume the full step budget on the first attempt and make retries meaningless.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1069-1077 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A mid-chain V2 posting failure returns 0 after logging `::error::`.
  WHY: the caller treats the torn write as success, so orphaned V2 fragments accumulate and the next poll can revert to stale V1 state.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-158 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The substring-overlap filter can drop a legitimate `must_not_contain` pattern when its regex source is a strict substring of a `must_contain` regex on the same file.
  WHY: the verifier can silently stop checking a real forbidden line if it happens to be covered by a longer required line.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1098-1109 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk` redirects `gh api` stdout and stderr to `/dev/null` unconditionally.
  WHY: failures such as HTTP 422, 403, 429, or network errors are reduced to a generic caller-side error with no API details for diagnosis.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1073-1090 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` returns 0 from every V2 failure path.
  WHY: the poller treats torn or incomplete V2 chains as success, so the next cycle can read stale V1 state and respawn duplicate work.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1160-1184 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The V2 extract path accepts `candidate_state` without size or manifest validation beyond `is_valid_orchestrator_state_json`.
  WHY: malformed bytes that still satisfy the JSON shape check can be ingested as state and poison the poller.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-590 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` accepts arbitrarily large positive integers without an upper bound.
  WHY: a huge override can make attempt 1 burn the whole 60-minute step budget, so retries never run.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:341-344 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_is_state_comment` detects state comments via substring containment.
  WHY: test inputs that merely mention a state marker in prose can be filtered out as if they were real state comments.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-158 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_substring_overlap_drops` drops `must_not_contain` when its regex source is contained in any `must_contain` regex on the same file.
  WHY: a real forbidden pattern can be removed from verification, letting a regression slip through.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:230-248 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `cmd_extract` compacts `stitched_b64` with `re.sub(r"\s+", "", ...)` before base64 decoding.
  WHY: renderer-injected whitespace and corruption get normalized the same way, which makes torn-chain diagnostics less distinct.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1098-1113 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `gh_retry` API call redirects both stdout and stderr to `/dev/null`, discarding HTTP status/body diagnostics on failure.
  WHY: a failing chunk post only produces a generic `::error::Failed to post V2 state chunk`, making persistent API failures hard to diagnose.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1047-1090 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: V2 state-write failures return 0, so callers treat torn writes as successful while partial chunk chains remain on the issue.
  WHY: persisted state stays pinned at the last successful snapshot, which can cause duplicate advancement or issue creation on subsequent poll cycles.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-590 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-attempt timeout validation has no upper bound.
  WHY: a large value can let one attempt consume the entire 60-minute step budget before retries execute.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
